scene: Holding the warm canister, factory exit gates slide open into daylight.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a bright rooftop dock. On the far left, a tethered paper-lantern balloon bobs gently. In the centre, the young woman with a black ponytail, red jacket, and white roller skates holds a glowing spice canister. Up high, an escalator climbs toward a hatch. On the far right waits a bamboo cable car.
shown: a giant paper-lantern balloon tethered to an open balcony on the far left
a gleaming escalator leading upward through an open hatch up high
a woven bamboo cable car resting at an open station on the far right
